 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 units.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and

 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS

 into :GLOBAL.donor_decision_code,

 units.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 units.contract_id = contracts.contract_id and
 contracts.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and

 exception

 CLEAR_ITEM;

 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and

---------------------- Edwin code ends here */

 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and

 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and

 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and

 result_status_1 != 'NT'

 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and

 where code = temp_abo_result
 and code_type = 'ABO' and

 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);

declare

 temp_life_span number(4,0);
 temp_base_dats date;
 cur_exp_date date;
 temp_max_dats date;
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 cursor c1 is
 select life_span, life_span_ind,
 B.proc_date base_dats
 from valid_product_attributes A, component_attributes B
 where life_span_ind is not null and
 life_span is not null and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and
 A.attrib_group = B.attrib_group and
 A.attrib_code =B.attrib_code and
 A.product_type = (SELECT product_type 
 FROM Valid_Products 
 WHERE product_code = 
 SUBSTR(:CTRL_BLK_1.product_code,1,5 ) and 
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme ) 
 AND unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 B.product_code = :product_code;
begin
 if :GLOBAL.product_type not in ('RPL','RPFF') and
 :GLOBAL.product_type not like 'DU%'
 then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 reformat_date;
 --
 -- check if there are attributes associated to the
 -- component that have expirations associated to them
 --
 -- prev_exp_date has the base value;
 -- cur_exp_date has the value which is the current
 -- value after the calculation; If prev_exp_date >
 -- cur_exp_date, then prev_exp_date made equal to
 -- temp_expiry_dats (simple logic for calculation of
 -- minima
 --
 :GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute := 'N';
 begin
 prev_exp_date := add_months(sysdate,12*100);
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute := 'Y';
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'D'
 then
 cur_exp_date := trunc(c1_rec.base_dats)+
 (to_number(c1_rec.life_span)+1-(1/(24*60)));
 end if;
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'Y'
 then
 cur_exp_date :=add_months(trunc(c1_rec.base_dats),
 12*c1_rec.life_span);
 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'H'
 then
 cur_exp_date := c1_rec.base_dats +
 (c1_rec.life_span/24);
 end if;
 if prev_exp_date > cur_exp_date
 then
 prev_exp_date := cur_exp_date;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- Check the expiry date/time based on the product
 --
 begin
 select life_span, life_span_ind
 into temp_life_span, temp_life_span_ind
 from valid_products
 where product_code = SUBSTR(:product_code,1,5) and
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and 
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 if temp_life_span_ind = 'D'
 then
 cur_exp_date := trunc(:coll_Date) +
 (temp_life_span+1-(1/(24*60)));
 end if;
 if temp_life_span_ind = 'Y'
 then
 cur_exp_date :=
 add_months(trunc(:coll_date),12*temp_life_span);
 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;
 if temp_life_span_ind = 'H'
 then
 begin
 select bleed_start_time
 into temp_bleed_start_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in selecting bleed time');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 cur_exp_date := temp_bleed_start_time +
 (temp_life_span/24);
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if prev_exp_date > cur_exp_date
 then
 prev_exp_date := cur_exp_date;
 end if;
 if (to_char(prev_exp_date,'MM-DD-YYYY') !=
 to_char(:expiry_date_128,'MM-DD-YYYY') and
 (:s_expiry_date_128 != 'M' or
 :s_expiry_date_128 != 'M')) or
 (to_char(prev_exp_date,'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI') !=
 to_char(:expiry_date_128,'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI') and
 (:s_expiry_date_128 = 'M' or
 :s_expiry_date_128 = 'M'))
 then
 if :expiry_date_128 is not null
 then
 GO_ITEM('expiry_date_128');
 end if;
 show_error('1170');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :s_actual_expiry_date := prev_exp_date;
 end if;
 --
 -- Check if the component has already expired
 --
 if nvl(:s_actual_expiry_date,sysdate+1) < sysdate
 then
 show_error('7001');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 end;

PROCEDURE find_exp_date IS
 temp_scan_date VARCHAR2(9);

 cursor c1 is

 where life_span_ind is not null and

 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and
 A.attrib_group = B.attrib_group and

 A.product_type = (SELECT product_type 
 FROM Valid_Products 
 WHERE product_code = 
 SUBSTR(:CTRL_BLK_1.product_code,1,5 ) and 
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme ) 
 AND unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 B.product_code = :product_code;
BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.product_type not in ('RPL','RPFF') and :GLOBAL.product_type not like 'DU%'
 THEN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 --reformat_date;
 --
 -- check if there are attributes associated to the
 -- component that have expirations associated to them
 --
 -- prev_exp_date has the base value;
 -- cur_exp_date has the value which is the current
 -- value after the calculation; If prev_exp_date >
 -- cur_exp_date, then prev_exp_date made equal to
 -- temp_expiry_dats (simple logic for calculation of
 -- minima
 --
 :GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute := 'N';
 begin
 prev_exp_date := add_months(sysdate,12*100);
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :GLOBAL.exp_based_on_attribute := 'Y';
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'D'
 then
 cur_exp_date := trunc(c1_rec.base_dats)+
 (to_number(c1_rec.life_span)+1-(1/(24*60)));
 end if;
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'Y'
 then
 cur_exp_date :=add_months(trunc(c1_rec.base_dats),
 12*c1_rec.life_span);
 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;
 if c1_rec.life_span_ind = 'H'
 then
 cur_exp_date := c1_rec.base_dats +
 (c1_rec.life_span/24);
 end if;
 if prev_exp_date > cur_exp_date
 then
 prev_exp_date := cur_exp_date;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- Check the expiry date/time based on the product
 --
 begin
 select life_span, life_span_ind
 into temp_life_span, temp_life_span_ind
 from valid_products
 where product_code = SUBSTR(:product_code,1,5) and
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and /* MODIFIED BY HCL */ 
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 if temp_life_span_ind = 'D'
 then
 cur_exp_date := trunc(:coll_Date) +
 (temp_life_span+1-(1/(24*60)));
 end if;
 if temp_life_span_ind = 'Y'
 then
 cur_exp_date :=
 add_months(trunc(:coll_date),12*temp_life_span);
 cur_exp_date := cur_exp_date + 1 - (1/(24*60));
 end if;
 if temp_life_span_ind = 'H'
 then
 begin
 select bleed_start_time
 into temp_bleed_start_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in selecting bleed time');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 cur_exp_date := temp_bleed_start_time +
 (temp_life_span/24);
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if prev_exp_date > cur_exp_date
 then
 prev_exp_date := cur_exp_date;
 end if;

 :s_actual_expiry_date := prev_exp_date;

 if nvl(:s_actual_expiry_date,sysdate+1) < sysdate then
 show_error('7001');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 END IF;
END;

procedure show_reason (error_cd in VARCHAR2, add_msg in VARCHAR2 := '')
 is
 text VARCHAR2(80);
 temp_audit_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 begin
 select decode(error_type,'E','***:'||error_code,
 'M','***:'||error_code,
 'W','***:'||error_code,
 ''||error_code)||
 ': '||nvl(error,'Error desc missing'),
 audit_flag
 into text, temp_audit_flag
 from valid_errors_lab
 where error_code = error_cd;
 if add_msg is null
 then
 :s_reason := text||'.';
 else
 :s_reason := text||' '||add_msg||'.';
 end if;
 down;
 if temp_audit_flag = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_sysdate');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd');
 :GLOBAL.user_err_sysdate :=
 to_char(sysdate,'DD-MON-YY HH24:MI:SS');
 :GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd := error_cd;
 insert into user_error_log_tmp
 (insert_dats, user_id, program_name, error_code,
 unit_id, chapter_id, coll_date, component_prefix,
 product_code) values
 (sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd, :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code);
 :GLOBAL.system_label_decision :=
 :GLOBAL.display_system_label_decision;
 user_exit('user_error');
 if form_failure
 then
 message('User exit to trap user error failed');
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := '';
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in error log');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 message
 ('Err:No error description for error code '||error_cd);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 message
 ('Err:Too many descriptions for error code '||error_cd);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
